# camundacluster_tenant_member_group (Resource)

Assigns a group to a Camunda cluster tenant

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "camundacluster_tenant" "acme" {
  tenant_id = "acme"
  name      = "Acme"
}

resource "camundacluster_group" "developers" {
  group_id = "developers"
  name     = "Developers"
}

resource "camundacluster_tenant_member_group" "developers" {
  tenant_id = camundacluster_tenant.acme.id
  group_id  = camundacluster_group.developers.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The ID of the group.
- `tenant_id` (String) The ID of the tenant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID of the assignment (percent-encoded `tenant_id/group_id`). Also used as the import ID: `terraform import camundacluster_tenant_member_group.example <tenant_id>/<group_id>`, with each component percent-encoded if it contains a `/`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import camundacluster_tenant_member_group.developers acme/developers
```
